_note: The two graders agreed on all 47 items and both assertions (agreement-P6.json), so there was nothing to settle; the consensus is their agreed mapping, with grader A's reasons.

answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of the 38 judged findings, 29 map to seeded defects, 6 are real but not seeded (F-0022, F-0105, F-0056, F-0058, F-0067, F-0079) and 3 are not a problem (F-0020, F-0106, F-0054), so precision = 35/38 = 0.92 and strict precision = 29/38 = 0.76. Recall by meaning: judged findings alone cover 11 of 14 (all except D02, D11, D13) = 0.79; adding the 9 tool findings covers D02 (F-0019) and D11 (F-0015), giving 13/14 = 0.93, with only D13 (slot length and end time only in a tooltip) missed.

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply opens with a numbered 'Fix first' list headed by the 4/4 double-tap cancel, follows it with 'Next tier, all smaller fixes', and flags the 4/4 online-change gap as 'Your decision'. Under Caveats it says 'Not tested with real residents or real screen readers. VoiceOver and TalkBack runs are still needed.'

mapping.title: Current step shown only by bold, not exposed to screen readers
mapping.reason: The review's own reply says the markup does mark the current step with aria-current="step" and calls this a probable false alarm, so the claim is wrong on the review's own evidence.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots pulled above the Morning heading, out of their group
mapping.reason: CSS order:-1 moves 'Few left' slots to the front, so the Morning and Afternoon headings no longer sit above their slots. That is the D10 reordering.

mapping.title: Selected day button barely distinguishable from unselected days
mapping.reason: The pressed day differs only by a 1 px thicker border and a 1.16:1 tint, so a resident, especially one with low vision or using forced colours, cannot easily confirm which day they are booking. No seeded defect covers this.

mapping.title: Cancelled booking page headed 'Booked' and says show it at the gate
mapping.reason: D09 includes the cancelled done page that is still titled 'Booked' and says 'Show this at the gate', which is how a resident ends up at the gate with a cancelled booking.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' returns with Today selected, not the booked day
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and reopens on today. That is D12.

mapping.title: Expired-slot message gives no next step and blanks the slot
mapping.reason: This is the lapsed hold: 'This slot is no longer available.' with the slot line turned into a dash, without saying the hold ran out. That is D08.

mapping.title: Slot button focus outline removed with no replacement
mapping.reason: The injected '.slot:focus{outline:0}' leaves the slot buttons with no visible focus. That is D05.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved ahead of time order, visual and focus order diverge
mapping.reason: Per-button order:-1 pulls 'Few left' slots out of time order while Tab keeps DOM order. That is D10.

mapping.title: Slot grid wider than content box at 360 px and below
mapping.reason: The script sizes the columns from the window width, not the content box, so the grid overflows at 360 px and below. That is D04.

mapping.title: Book this slot shows no visible change during its 1.5 s wait
mapping.reason: Book doing nothing visible while the booking is made is part of D09.

mapping.title: Second tap on Book saves the booking as cancelled
mapping.reason: A second press during the pending wait turns the booking into a cancellation. That is the core of D09.

mapping.title: Done page heading says 'Booked' when the status is cancelled
mapping.reason: This is the same cancelled-but-titled-'Booked' done page that D09 describes.

mapping.title: Slot list empty with no loading indicator after a day change
mapping.reason: The grid and status line stay empty for 0.9 s with nothing saying slots are coming. That is the D01 wait.

mapping.title: Next does nothing while slots are loading
mapping.reason: D01 explicitly includes Next doing nothing during the load.

mapping.title: Slots already past today offered as free, rejected only at booking
mapping.reason: Today's slots that have started are offered and then refused at the final step. That is D06.

mapping.title: Returning to the when step drops the saved day and slot
mapping.reason: This is a broader statement of 'Change slot' landing on today with nothing selected. Fixing it fixes D12.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag colours below 4.5:1
mapping.reason: The run-time 'few' colours give about 3.0:1 (light) and 3.4:1 (dark) for 16 px bold text. That is D03.

mapping.title: Permit not checked on vehicle step; error only after booking, no link
mapping.reason: Next accepting an empty permit, with the rule enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field, is D07.

mapping.title: Vehicle step error summary links do not move focus to a control
mapping.reason: Activating an error link scrolls to a container but focuses nothing, so a keyboard or switch user has to hunt for the vehicle or waste control they must fix. No seeded defect covers this.

mapping.title: Vehicle and waste errors not programmatically tied to controls
mapping.reason: The finding is speculative by its own wording ('do not appear to be', 'may not announce', 'this needs an accessibility-tree check'), with no evidence that the association is actually missing.

mapping.title: 5-minute slot hold never disclosed
mapping.reason: No page shows the five-minute hold, and it lapses unseen. That is D08.

mapping.title: Expired-hold error does not say the hold expired or link to another slot
mapping.reason: This is the D08 message, 'This slot is no longer available.', with the slot dropped and no reason given.

mapping.title: Slot area shows the previous day's caption over an empty list while loading
mapping.reason: The grid is empty for about a second with no loading text, so nothing says slots are coming. That is the D01 wait.

mapping.title: Slot hold and its time limit not stated after choosing a slot
mapping.reason: The hold and its length are never shown, and the only signal is the final-step error. That is D08.

mapping.title: Permit field shown and unmarked for cars; explanation behind an 'i' icon
mapping.reason: This is about the permit rule: the field is not labelled vans-and-trailers-only, and the explanation sits behind the icon-only info button. Both are part of D07.

mapping.title: 'Book this slot' shows no pending state
mapping.reason: Book staying unchanged and enabled for about 1.5 s is the 'Book doing nothing visible' part of D09.

mapping.title: Confirmation omits the day, the arrival window and the vehicle
mapping.reason: The done page lacks the day, the slot and the vehicle. That is D14.

mapping.title: Vehicle step does not show the chosen day and slot
mapping.reason: The check step restates the day, slot and 20-minute window with Change links, as the reply notes. Not repeating them mid-flow is a design choice with no harm shown.

mapping.title: Permit help says apply on the council site but gives no link
mapping.reason: A van or trailer owner who learns they need a permit is told to apply elsewhere with no link, so they have to search the council site on their phone to continue. No seeded defect covers this.

mapping.title: Two-working-day permit lead time revealed only after a slot is chosen
mapping.reason: The permit information is held inside the collapsed 'About vans and trailers' panel behind the icon-only button. That is the hidden permit rule in D07.

mapping.title: No way to change or cancel an existing booking online
mapping.reason: Residents book in the evening for weekend visits, but changing or cancelling needs a weekday 09:00-17:00 phone call, so they cannot move a booking when they need to. D12 is only the in-flow 'Change slot', so this is not seeded.

mapping.title: Vans and trailers help is an unlabelled icon among the vehicle buttons
mapping.reason: D07 says the permit rule is given only behind an icon-only info button. This finding is that button.

mapping.title: Past slots on Today offered as free, rejected at the final step
mapping.reason: Today's past slots are selectable and refused only after Book. That is D06.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' reopens on Today, not the booked day and slot
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day, including after an expired hold. That is D12.

mapping.title: Invalid 'Another day' date leaves the previous day's slots selectable
mapping.reason: After a bad date, Today's grid stays live under the error, so a resident can pick a slot and book a day they did not ask for. No seeded defect covers this.

mapping.title: Keyboard focus on slot buttons has no visible indicator
mapping.reason: Tabbing to a slot shows no ring or change. That is D05.

mapping.title: No indication of how long a chosen slot is held
mapping.reason: No page shows the hold, its length or the time left. That is D08.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel an existing booking
mapping.reason: This duplicates F-0058: the only route is a weekday phone line while residents book in evenings and visit at weekends, so they cannot change a booking when they need to. Not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: axe color-contrast failure on the 'Few left' tag (tool)
mapping.reason: 3.02:1 for 16 px bold #bd7d0f on #fbefda. That is the D03 'Few left' tag contrast.

mapping.title: 'Few left' text contrast below 4.5:1 (tool)
mapping.reason: 'Few left' at 3.02:1 is D03.

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px (tool)
mapping.reason: The page scrolls sideways at 320 px because of the slot area. That is D04.

mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px (tool)
mapping.reason: This is the same overflow at 320 px, caused by the slot grid. That is D04.

mapping.title: Slot count status message not announced (tool)
mapping.reason: The live region is inserted with the text, so '20 slots free…' is never announced. That is D11.

mapping.title: No visible focus indicator on slot 08:00 (tool)
mapping.reason: Focusing a slot button changes no pixels. That is D05.

mapping.title: Focus order jumps back to '08:20 Few left' (tool)
mapping.reason: Focus jumps around the grid because 'Few left' slots are visually reordered. That is D10.

mapping.title: No progress shown during 1.2 s 'Car with trailer' operation (tool)
mapping.reason: The 1.2 s wait after choosing a permit vehicle on the vehicle step is the delayed permit field in D07.

mapping.title: Layout shift above 0.1 budget, #opening moved (tool)
mapping.reason: CLS 0.169, with #opening shifted when the slots arrive. That is D02.
